subject: Update to Permit Filing Fee Schedule
overview: The board approved a revised permit filing fee schedule, marking the first update since 1974, and discussed potential revisions to its internal rules and regulations.

items.title: Rules and Regulations Review
items.summary: Tabled discussion on updating the board's rules and regulations, including remote meeting protocols and application deadlines, until members can review the current document.

items.title: Permit Filing Fee Schedule
items.summary: Approved a revised fee schedule for special permits, site plan reviews, and Approval Not Required (ANR) filings effective January 31, 2024. The board scheduled a revisit of the new rates in six months to evaluate their impact.

items.title: Routine Business and Staffing Updates
items.summary: Approved the November 15, 2023, meeting minutes and reviewed the 2024 meeting schedule. Staff announced that the department will be fully staffed by mid-January following several new hires, including an economic development director.
